A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' were [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] beings with [[Color/Legends|red]]-colored carapace-like skin and a [[Tooth/Legends|tooth]]-filled [[Mouth/Legends|maw]]. [[Voegliss's parents|Two members]] of the [[Species/Legends|species]] at one point attacked the team of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Devlor Samt]] on a [[Unidentified world (Voegliss)|world]] that the former were not [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to, being eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] themselves. Samt subsequently raised the [[Alien/Legends|alien's]] [[Youngling/Legends|infant]] [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Voegliss]], as his own child, with the young being ultimately being pressed into service as an Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]-in-training.

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that stood 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height had [[Color/Legends|red]]-colored, hard, carapace-like skin, [[Claw/Legends|claws]], a [[Tooth/Legends|tooth]]-filled [[Mouth/Legends|maw]] with large fangs, and hooded, glinting [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Members of the species were still young at the age of fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="HR" />

==Society and culture==
Members of the species' society identified as belonging to at least one&mdash;male&mdash;[[Gender/Legends|gender]].<ref name="HR" />

==The species in the galaxy==
At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], three members&mdash;[[Voegliss's parents|two adults]] and their [[Youngling/Legends|infant]] son&mdash;of the species&mdash;which was not in Imperial records&mdash;were present on a supposedly uninhabited [[Unidentified world (Voegliss)|world]] that they were not [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to. The two older [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] launched a fierce and terrifying attack on the team of the Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Devlor Samt]]. The attackers were eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]], while their son was discovered nearby. Samt then went on to raise the alien&mdash;[[Voegliss]]&mdash;as his son. When Voegliss was fifteen, the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] captured him on the orders of a [[Unidentified Moff (Voegliss)|Moff]] of the Empire, who viewed the alien as a potentially useful operative. Voegliss was subsequently trained as an Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], in the process becoming a highly capable killer.<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species of which Voegliss was a member was mentioned in the [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book additionally presents a sample [[Unidentified alien assassin-in-training|player character]]&mdash;[[:File:AlienAssassinInTraining-HeroesAndRogues.png|illustrated]] by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] as an alien being with a carapace-like skin&mdash;who is an Imperial assassin-in-training with identical equipment to Voegliss's as well as similar biographical details such as being raised by an Imperial individual. Their biography also differs from that of Voegliss's in other regards, however, and this article refrains from assuming the two alien beings belonged to the same species.<ref name="HR" />
